_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Threat Hazard Assessment
summary: Describes the contents of a threat hazard assessment used to design a hazard assessment test program that evaluates the safety and insensitive munitions characteristics of non-nuclear ordnance.
description_purpose: This item describes the contents of a threat hazard assessment. The assessment aids in designing a hazard assessment test program to evaluate the safety and insensitive munitions characteristics of non-nuclear ordnance.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated by the "Test parameters" paragraph of MIL-STD-2105.

This DID is used in conjunction with the life-cycle environmental profile of the munition being assessed.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Threat Hazard Assessment (THA) shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The THA shall contain an analysis of the munition life cycle. The THA shall identify potential hazards, both qualitatively and quantitatively and their causes and effects. The THA shall include the following:

children.title: Identification of potential accident and combat threat scenarios
Identification of the characteristics (stimuli level, duration, likelihood of occurrence, etc.) of each potential accident and combat threat scenario
Description of the anticipated response mode of each munition subsystem to the identified threat scenarios
Assessment of the effect of the response of each munition subsystem upon mission capability and completion
